posts.title: On LLMs and free software
posts.description: Like many, I’ve been thinking a lot about the impact of LLMs on the free software community. In the GNOME community, there have been a couple of posts on Planet GNOME and Discourse , and assorted heated discussions on Matrix and Mastodon.
